To apply for Blue Card you need:

- Passport
 - Employment contract with a minimum salary matching the requirements
 - Education documents confirming qualifications
 - Application for Blue Card
Make sure you have all the necessary documents before submitting the application.
To start a business in Poland, you need:

- Passport
 - Company registration application
 - Business plan
 - Documents confirming capital availability
Make sure all necessary documents are collected before submitting the application.

To obtain Polish citizenship, you need: - Citizenship application - Passport - Proof of legal residence in Poland for at least 3 years - Documents proving knowledge of the Polish language Make sure all necessary documents are collected before submitting the application.
